svg.title: When Windows keyboard input behaves strangely: How to turn off Sticky Keys and Filter Keys and a checklist
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
When Windows keyboard input behaves strangely: How to
turn off Sticky Keys and Filter Keys and a checklist
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-09
Sticky Keys: Enabled by pressing Shift
five times
According to Microsoft's official list, pressing
Shift five times turns Sticky Keys on or off.
Filter Keys: Enabled by holding the
right Shift for 8 seconds
Holding the right Shift key for 8 seconds turns
Filter Keys on or off.
Turn them off in Settings:
Accessibility > Keyboard
In Windows 11, go to Settings > Accessibility >
Keyboard and turn off Sticky Keys and Filter
Keys.
Distinguish Toggle Keys from device
problems
Holding Num Lock for 5 seconds turns on Toggle
Keys, which may cause sounds when you press Caps
Lock, Num Lock, or Scroll Lock.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
